spans.s: SV0192 फाणित phāṇita Molasses is a semisolid condensed sugarcane preparation, traditionally used to prepare Arișta, Asava and other forms of alcoholic fermentation. Its heavy in nature,Sweet in taste, nutitive and non-aphrodisiac and aggravates Tri-Doṣa.
BK0119 फांट phāṁṭa a filtrate obtained by steeping the soft & aromatic substances in boiled water in liquid doses form
